intent: Each climber has 3 wind boosts per round. Pressing B (or pushing down) gives a 1.5 s upward gust of 200 px/s, drawn as a glowing swirl around the player; boosts refill every round, so players choose when to spend them to skip a hard section.
accept: Pressing B (down input) while boosts remain lifts the player upward for 1.5 s and uses one of 3 boosts
After 3 boosts further presses do nothing; a new round refills to 3
A glowing swirl is visible around a boosting player in the after clip
Boost speed 200 px/s is applied (about 13 px per tick at 15 ticks/s)
